header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Jaidev Sharma advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Mohan Lal K. Rathore advocate for the respondents No.5 & 6.
body: Through the instant petition, the petitioners have challenged order dated 16.07.2019, passed by the learned 2 nd Additional District Judge-II, Umerkot in Civil Revision No.22 of 2017, whereby learned appellate Court set aside the order dated 08.03.2017, passed by the learned 1st Senior Civil Judge, Umerkot in F.C Suit No.Nil of 2017 and order dated 13.11.2017 passed on the application under Section 12(2) C.P.C and rejected the plaint of F.C Suit No. Nil of 2017 titled Prem Singh v. Mukhtiarkar Revenue and others. After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for both the parties agreed that impugned order dated 16.07.2019 passed by learned appellate Court, including order passed by learned 1 st Senior Civil Judge, Umerkot dated 13.11.2017 may be set aside and matter be remanded to the learned Trial Court for passing fresh order, after hearing to all the concerned and perusal of the impugned orders I am of the view that the same were not passed in accordance with law, therefore, this petition is disposed of by setting aside the orders stated above and remanded the matter to the trial Court to pass fresh order on an application under Section 12(2) C.P.C after hearing all the parties.
The instant petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
